age_limit.details: Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) is applicable only against posts reserved for the respective category; if applying against an unreserved post, such candidates are assessed under general merit with no age relaxation. PwBD age relaxation applies irrespective of whether the post is reserved, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs. Ex-servicemen with at least six months' continuous service in the Armed Forces may deduct their actual service period from their age; if the resultant age does not exceed the prescribed maximum by more than 3 years, they are deemed to satisfy the age condition. Maximum upper age of the applicant, after all possible relaxations, shall not exceed 56 years.

Only full-time regular courses from UGC-recognized/AICTE-approved institutions are considered. | General, EWS and OBC (NCL) candidates: minimum 65% marks in the Bachelor's degree in Engineering. SC/ST/PwBD candidates: minimum 60% marks (a 5% relaxation), applicable only against posts reserved for SC/ST/PwBD. SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts are assessed under general merit standards with no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage. No rounding off of marks is allowed (e.g., 64.99% is not treated as 65% for UR category). Eligible candidates: those who completed their Bachelor's degree in Engineering in 2026, OR those currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree course. Candidates who completed their Engineering degree in 2025 or earlier are not eligible to apply. Final-year candidates must have secured the minimum prescribed percentage (65%/60% as applicable) in aggregate up to the last semester/year examination at the time of applying, and must submit the final degree certificate (or at least a provisional certificate) and all semester/year mark sheets confirming the minimum prescribed percentage by 31 August 2027.

Important: No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GAIL Executive Trainee (GATE-2027)
content_sections.text: Register for and appear in GATE-2027 as per the instructions and timelines notified by the GATE-2027 Organizing Institute, in the GATE paper corresponding to your discipline. Download your GATE-2027 admit card with registration number once activated, from the official GATE website. Visit the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://gailonline.com. Apply online, indicating your GATE-2027 Registration Number, within the application window: 17 February 2027, 11:00 AM to 18 March 2027, 6:00 PM . Apply for only one post/discipline; applications for more than one post/discipline will not be considered. Important: No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is GAIL recruiting for through GATE-2027?
faq.answer: GAIL (India) Limited will recruit Executive Trainees (ET) in Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical disciplines using GATE-2027 marks.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply on the GAIL website?
faq.answer: The GAIL application window opens on 17 February 2027 at 11:00 AM and closes on 18 March 2027 at 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in the relevant discipline (or an equivalent/allied branch as listed) with a minimum of 65% marks for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates, or 60% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 26 years as on 18 March 2027, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and 10 years for PwBD, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply with GATE 2026 marks?
faq.answer: No. Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment; GATE marks from 2026 or earlier will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for more than one discipline?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one post/discipline; multiple applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are final-year students eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree are eligible, subject to securing the minimum prescribed aggregate percentage up to the last semester/year at the time of applying, and submitting the final degree certificate and mark sheets by 31 August 2027.
